# Vendored tinyuz source

The `compress` and `decompress` directories are unmodified source files from
[`sisong/tinyuz`](https://github.com/sisong/tinyuz) release `v1.1.1`, commit
`1d74ffa4d453796df352df470733f45dfa099bb1`.

tinyuz is distributed under the MIT license in `LICENSE`. OpenRGB uses it to
produce the compressed RGB payload expected by Lian Li wireless controllers.
